recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. The requested rename was applied historically and was later superseded by the final adherence model.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification Pharmacy issue saying MedicationStatement.wasNotGiven was copied from MedicationAdministration terminology and should use taking language; the approved resolution changed wasNotGiven to wasNotTaken and reasonNotGiven to reasonNotTaken.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly names FHIR-5701, but d406f9a2c0 changed the old MedicationStatement spreadsheet and examples from wasNotGiven/reasonNotGiven to wasNotTaken/reasonNotTaken immediately after the 2015 Pharmacy ballot-resolution vote.
additional_context: FHIR-8009 is the same change family and records the earlier ballot comment. Later issues FHIR-8010 and FHIR-12470 revised the old notTaken/taken status interpretation, and FHIR-19468/FHIR-19470/FHIR-39271 moved current taking/not-taking semantics into adherence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current active source has no active wasNotGiven/reasonNotGiven fields and represents non-use through MedicationStatement.adherence, including not-taking and adherence.reason.

related_jiras.note: Later DSTU1 ballot comment asking whether notGiven fields were relevant; its resolution points back to the same rename.
Examined status restrictions for the renamed wasNotTaken flag; already audited on the combined branch.
Updated the DSTU2/STU3 status plus notTaken/taken guidance and is already represented on the combined branch.
Removed not-taken from status and directed taking/not-taking semantics to adherence.
Confirms status is statement-record status and adherence reflects whether medication is being taken.

evidence_items.summary: MedicationStatement is active; current source defines MedicationStatement.adherence and only retains wasNotTaken in the legacy [r2-renames] map.
evidence_items.learned: There is no active current wasNotGiven/reasonNotGiven source to correct, and taking/non-taking is represented by adherence.

evidence_items.summary: Later Published Pharmacy decisions removed not-taken from status, added/renamed adherence, and reaffirmed that adherence reflects taking/not-taking.
evidence_items.learned: These later decisions supersede the old wasNotTaken element without reviving wasNotGiven terminology.
